correctness.rationale: The phase-prefix construction establishes exact branching sizes equal to subgroup stabilizer orders. At length 2p, order-p branching forces an all-even phase prefix, incompatible with order-two branching both before and after. Consequently each path has branching product at most 2^(p-1), and the equal-child probability argument bounds all leaves by that number. An explicit family with p-1 independent binary inter-block choices has 2^(p-1) distinct full 2p-cycles with identical time-indexed comparisons. Exhaustive checks for n=6 and n=10 verify the formula, and constructive checks also cover n=14 and n=22, but the infinite claim follows from the proof.
